name: New Extracted Data
description: Emit new event for each newly extracted data record for a given AlgoDocs document (polls GET /v1/extracted_data/{documentId}). Each extraction record's stable `id` is used for deduplication. Run the **List Documents** action to find a valid document ID before configuring this source. An optional filter narrows emissions to records whose extracted `data` matches a provided key or value substring. [See the documentation](https://api.algodocs.com/).
